record.scope: One run of the automated rehearsal of the first demonstration (scripts/rehearsal, step list version 8) against main in the real application: a production build in headless Chrome over the DevTools protocol, one page per session, a fresh synthetic workspace on acceptance slot 0, the hosted models through the product's configured client, main's production derivative worker with its depth model and its tile worker, and the host playing the run's workspace at its shipped pace. The starter's steps are rehearsal 7's: the small square, a model chosen for a group of four, a decision read in the inspector and from the API, someone standing or talking because their model chose it, birds on the shared clock, the photographs' path to a made world, the Companion inside it and people on its declared floor. The town session makes a market town from values moved inside the served ranges and waits for its tiles to bake; its people are played and read crossing a tile seam, its vehicles read moving; a model is chosen for four of its people, and a comparison of that group under two models with a same-model control is started from the application's Compare models and read in the Compare view and by the developer client; the Companion is asked what happened in the town; and a second town is made from the values an open model drafted from a description in words. Last, the workspace is exported as a judge seed and restored into a fresh database and data directory, where each town's tiles are read back. The human review of the photographs is the rehearsal driver's stand-in for a person's review, stated in stand_in_disclosure. Each step is a person's action with its declared observable results; each gate of docs/product-direction.md is reported with its first failed step.

steps.reason: What this rehearsal runs, and what it cannot. It runs main's production derivative worker with its depth model (runtime.derivative_worker: MoGe-2 on this machine's CPU), which makes a point map of each reviewed photograph, and the scene grouping that closes each job; wait-for-depth-and-grouping observes both, and a made world draws each photograph from its point map. It does not run multi-view reconstruction. Scene grouping selects a group for pose recovery only when it holds at least three photographs, each with a point map (SceneGroupPosePolicy in exulanica/ingest/scene_selection.py), and the rehearsal's drawings are a day apart, so each is its own group and no scene job exists. The scene worker (exulanica-scene-worker) also requires the pose runtime image by digest as provenance (exulanica/ingest/scene_worker_command.py), and this machine builds no image, so it cannot be started here with a truthful record; Gaussian training needs GPU compute this machine does not have. No control in the application shows a scene's coverage.

what_this_does_not_show: The human review of every photograph was recorded by the rehearsal driver through the drawer's own controls as a stand-in for a person's review; no person inspected these photographs, and every gate resting on it reports passed_on_stand_in or worse, never a plain pass.
The photographs are synthetic drawings in a synthetic workspace; no personal photograph is involved.
No multi-view reconstruction ran (reconstruct-scene-geometry states why).
One run: the Companion's answers, the model's decisions and the drafted values vary between runs.
Access used the production build's operator token gate; account sign-in was not exercised.
No person observed the run and no demonstration footage was recorded; no frame time was judged.
The town's people are read crossing a seam and drawn; their walking pace is sampled only in the starter's square.
One group of four in each world was decided by one open model; the people were not split into several groups under different models.
The comparison ran one development seed, which is never judged; its verdict claims no difference, and one seed says nothing about which model serves people better.
The judge seed was restored into a fresh database on the run's own server and an empty data directory, not into the judge deployment's containers.
Other work loaded the machine during the run (machine_load, from the GPU slot's own log lines); the times are not timing measurements.
